targets.rawSql:
SELECT sr."time", COALESCE(m.name, right(replace(sr.sensor_id, ':', ''), 4)) AS metric, sr.temperature_cal AS temperature
FROM sensor_readings_cal sr JOIN sensor_meta m USING (sensor_id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(sr."time") AND m.owner = 'mine' AND m.place = 'Vaunu' AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) <= 10800
UNION ALL
SELECT a.bucket, COALESCE(m.name, right(replace(a.sensor_id, ':', ''), 4)) AS metric, a.temp_avg_cal AS temperature
FROM sensor_readings_1min_cal a JOIN sensor_meta m USING (sensor_id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.bucket) AND m.owner = 'mine' AND m.place = 'Vaunu' AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) > 10800
ORDER BY 1
